description: This file defines a PHP class 'Store' within the OpenCart admin extension modules namespace. It includes methods for displaying the store configuration page and saving module settings, typical of a controller in an MVC architecture.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Controller class handling the store module's admin interface, including displaying the settings page and saving configuration data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the store module configuration page, sets breadcrumbs, loads language strings, and gathers data for rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the store module settings via AJAX, updating the configuration and returning a JSON response.
